description: This file contains code for parsing and representing 'TalkDirective' configuration objects from JSON input in an Android application. It defines data classes for directives and parse results, and includes a parser object with methods to parse text into structured directives, handling various JSON keys and unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Data class representing various optional configuration parameters for speech directive, such as voice ID, model ID, speech speed, rate, stability, similarity, style, speaker boost, seed, normalization, language, output format, latency tier, and a flag for running once.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the result of parsing a directive, including the directive object (if successfully parsed), the remaining stripped text, and a list of unknown JSON keys encountered during parsing.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method for parsing input text to extract a TalkDirective object if present. It normalizes line endings, extracts JSON between braces, parses it into a JsonObject, constructs the TalkDirective, and identifies unknown keys. It returns a TalkDirectiveParseResult with the parsed directive, remaining text, and unknown keys.
